Game Overview

In Avoid the Spikes, the core idea is straightforward: dodge menacing spikes in this adrenaline-fueled arcade challenge where precision and timing are crucial. Navigate through dangerous environments, balancing between soaring high and dipping low. With quick reflexes, survive longer to earn gems and unlock vibrant skins, perfecting your strategy as you chase the ultimate high score.

Avoid the Spikes keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Dodge menacing spikes in this adrenaline-fueled arcade challenge where precision and timing are crucial.
